affix.note: Prefix and suffix content is re-projected into the inner Form Field. Suffix actions require both solaris-form-suffix and solaris-form-suffix-action on the same element.

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

clearable.label: Status
clearable.note: When clearable, a clear button appears once a value is selected. Clearing emits the cleared event.

select.description: Single-select form control with local search, clearable selection, and rich option support. Rendered through Form Field with an overlay loading state.

examples.note: Basic single selection with its own label, placeholder, and options.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the select with its option components.

objects.label: Plan
objects.note: For object values, provide compareWith to match values and displayWith to render trigger text.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: Radius is forwarded to the inner Form Field. Global scale: md maps to 4px, lg to 8px, and xl renders as a pill.

searchable.label: Country
searchable.note: Local search filters options by label, description, and text content. Selection persists when filtered out.

size-density.label: Role
size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: the inner Form Field owns the outer height, the trigger keeps font and padding in sync.

select.title: Select
